title: Input schema of the Dropshipping Niche Finder Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs

minSearchVolume.title: Minimum Search Volume
minSearchVolume.description: Only analyze products with search volume above this threshold.

maxCompetition.title: Maximum Competition Level

minSellerRating.title: Minimum Seller Rating

priceRange.title: Price Range (Min - Max USD)

minMonthlyOrders.title: Minimum Monthly Orders

marginTarget.title: Target Profit Margin (%)

enableNicheScore.title: Calculate Niche Score
enableNicheScore.description: Calculate opportunity score for each product.
